structured_output.summary: The change implements TypedArray.prototype.findLast as the spec describes. It validates the receiver, takes the length, and calls a local FindViaPredicate that is hardwired to the descending direction. That helper does the callable check, then loops from length-1 down to 0 doing Get, Call and ToBoolean in spec order. It propagates every `?` error and returns the {-1, undefined} record when nothing matches. The 6 remaining failures throw the engine's not-implemented error for BigInt, which is honest partial work. I found no special-casing, swallowed errors or unrelated edits. I did not see the support helpers `validate_typed_array` and `length`, so I'm trusting that they do ValidateTypedArray and TypedArrayLength as the spec says.
